extDescription.message: Sends downloads and detected videos to RDM.

unpaired.message: Allow the extension in RDM's window, then try again

noAnswer.message: ✗ RDM did not answer: the browser keeps this download

notRunning.message: ✗ RDM is not running: open RDM, then try again

notWeb.message: ✗ This link cannot be downloaded outside the page (not a web address)

drm.message: DRM-protected video: it cannot be downloaded.

directRefused.message: Direct download refused by YouTube (anti-bot token required): use recording.

recordDetail.message: Muted playback at 2×, best quality$1 · the page will reload

openWatchPage.message: ✗ Open the video itself (its “watch” page) to record it.

adPlaying.message: Ad playing (not recorded) — recording resumes right after

clickToStart.message: Click the video to start recording

recordingDone.message: ✓ Recording complete: the file is in RDM

videoChanged.message: the page switched to another video

noStream.message: No stream detected — start playback, then try again.
